title: Cake for 12 guests near Marsden Park? Eggless 8-inch from $49.99
summary: Hosting 12 to 14 people in Marsden Park or Schofields? An 8-inch eggless cake serves exactly that, from $49.99. It's not a 6-inch that runs out, and it's not a 10-inch left half-eaten. 100% eggless, so nobody at the table has to ask what's in it. Choose from 15 flavours, add a photo print for $19.99, and order two days ahead. Pick up from Riverstone Shopping Centre, with free parking at the door. Open from 6am on weekdays.
